context: Tests that refinement entries hold a draft description and the skill never edits the ticket.

checklist.name: Chose the ticket-refinement type
checklist.description: The agent selects ticket-refinement.yaml and reads it before generating.

checklist.name: Proposed Ticket Description section
checklist.description: The entry has a `## Proposed Ticket Description` section.

checklist.name: Description inside a fenced block with a language
checklist.description: The amended description sits in a fenced `markdown` code block so inner headings do not become document headings.

checklist.name: Draft line present
checklist.description: The section opens with a `Draft for PROJ-2210 - review before applying; not yet applied.` style line.

checklist.name: Did not edit the ticket
checklist.description: The agent does not write the description to Jira, even though the user asked and a connection exists.

checklist.name: Explained the refusal
checklist.description: The agent says the skill produces a reviewable draft and that applying it is a separate, user-confirmed step.

checklist.name: Description is self-contained
checklist.description: The proposed text makes sense to a ticket reader who has not seen the entry.

checklist.name: Single H1 preserved
checklist.description: The entry still has exactly one H1 with a full date.
